topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The moment I unearthed the metal box, a curious thrill coursed through my veins. It was as if I were the first to set eyes upon a treasure long forgotten, even by the earth itself. The patina of age clung to its surface, whispering tales of yesteryears. I wiped away the soil with a reverence usually reserved for sacred relics. Inside, a faded diary, brittle photographs, and a watch that had long ago ceased to tick. Each item a window into a life, a chapter, I didn't recall writing. Yet, there was a comfort in the mystery, a sense that some stories are meant to be discovered, not remembered.
